boundary: This manifest records repository evidence and names deployment-owner evidence that must be attached outside the repository.

checks.title: PRD MVP acceptance criteria are mapped to evidence
checks.notes: The local and CI evidence is repeatable; this is not a claim that a hosted pilot has passed.

checks.title: End-to-end agent question, human decision, and context reuse pass in staging
checks.notes: Run against the isolated staging deployment and attach the private result, source revision, and environment identifier.

checks.title: Security and tenant-isolation evidence is reviewed
checks.notes: Repository and CI coverage is present; live RLS, identity-provider, and deployment-role evidence remains an external gate.

checks.title: Backup/restore and notification-failure scenarios are exercised
checks.notes: Injected worker failure and retry tests are repository evidence; a dated isolated restore and provider failure-window exercise are still required.

checks.title: Pilot onboarding and explicit continuation limitations are ready
checks.notes: The repository documents CLI/MCP-optional onboarding and manual continuation; pilot-specific briefing and acknowledgement belong in the private operations record.

checks.title: Pilot owners and incident/user-feedback response process are assigned
checks.notes: The repository provides the response contract and escalation procedure; named people, channels, and acknowledgement dates must be recorded privately.
